comments.text: There's one I don't really see anyone talking about yet.  A lot of Youtubers do giveaways.  They aren't truly giveaways, although you do have the option to do a free entry they usually make it very difficult to do and your odds are even smaller, but the most common way to enter is to buy merch.  This merch is usually pretty low quality stuff.  But you feel like you've gotten something for your money even if you lost the giveaway.  Realistically you didn't really want the items you bought or you could have gotten a better product for cheaper elsewhere if you did actually want it.  I never thought of myself as a gambler, but I really got caught up in the giveaway thing.  I'd tell myself if I don't win this is the last time I'll do it, but then I didn't and I'd enter in the next giveaway anyway because hey, I could maybe use that subpar item they are selling.  It's been awhile since I've bought anything but every now and then I see the giveaways and scroll through the merch to see if there's something I want before closing out and making the decision not to because I don't need that crap and I'm not going to win the car anyway.
